Two rays reach the interface 3 cm and 9 cm horizontally from the vertical through the point. stages.reconstruct: Draw point (0,−12) and interface z=0. For horizontal offsets 3,9, incidence angles are arctan(x/d)=14.04° and 36.87°. Snell gives refracted angles 18.87° and 53.13°. Extend each actual refracted ray backward from its interface crossing; d′=x/tan r gives 8.78 cm and 6.75 cm. Mark both intercepts on vertical axis and distinguish solid physical rays from dashed extensions. They are unequal; a universal virtual point is not exact for these off-axis rays.

stages.repair: Plot each actual transmitted ray using its own normal angle; back-project to the vertical axis and label its intercept separately.
stages.boundary_test: Repeat conceptually for offsets approaching zero. What common limiting depth do the intercepts approach?
